# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/spdl

## File: facebookresearch_spdl/.github/scripts/check_deps.py

Prompts

```
['run the check_deps script to verify spdl package dependencies and imported modules', 'run check_package_meta to verify spdl_core has no dependencies and spdl_io lists only NumPy', 'run check_imported_modules to verify spdl.pipeline and spdl.io import without third-party libraries', 'run _get_imported_3rd_party_modules to list all third-party modules currently loaded in sys.modules', 'run the main function to execute all dependency and import checks for spdl packages', 'run the script to download and install CUDA 12.3.2 components for the current platform', 'run detect_platform to auto-detect the CUDA platform identifier for the current system', 'run fetch_redistrib_metadata to download the redistrib JSON metadata for a given CUDA version', 'run the script to download cuda_cudart and cuda_nvcc archives and extract them to a directory', 'run get_component_path to look up the relative download path for a CUDA component and platform']
```

Usage

```
{'run_check_deps': 'run the check_deps script to verify spdl package dependencies and imported modules', 'run_check_package_meta': 'run check_package_meta to verify spdl_core has no dependencies and spdl_io lists only NumPy', 'run_check_imported_modules': 'run check_imported_modules to verify spdl.pipeline and spdl.io import without third-party libraries', 'run_get_imported_3rd_party_modules': 'run _get_imported_3rd_party_modules to list all third-party modules currently loaded in sys.modules', 'run_main': 'run the main function to execute all dependency and import checks for spdl packages'}
```
